notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton and any other creature.
When Reassembling Skeleton and the other creature die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability from step 1, causing any number of players to lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature, and you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.
